shots.content_purpose: Establish the two magicians facing the audience in their original costumes, show the simultaneous wand wave, and let the rising smoke hide both costumes so the exchange stays unseen.
shots.description: The shot opens on the stage of <Subject 3>, with the audience silhouettes running along the bottom edge and the lake-and-castle backdrop behind. <Subject 1> stands at the left and <Subject 2> at the right, both turned to face the audience, each holding a star-topped wand raised at chest height. The two wands cut the air with a soft whoosh as the magicians sweep them up and across in mirrored arcs at the same moment, then sweep back down. On the second sweep a puff of smoke bursts from the stage floor between them with a soft muffled pop, swells upward and spreads sideways until it wraps around both figures and hides their costumes and hats. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping both magicians and the two curtain edges in frame. The shot ends with the smoke filling the centre of the frame and both wands still raised above the cloud.

shots.content_purpose: Show the smoke clearing and the result of the trick clearly: the left magician now in white, the right magician now in black, both pairs of gloves still black.
shots.cut_reason: The exchanged costume colours and the unchanged black gloves must be read clearly, and the wide framing of shot 1 cannot deliver that while the drifting smoke still crosses the frame; the smoke is used as the cut medium.
shots.continuity_bridge: The smoke cloud filling the frame at the end of shot 1 is the same cloud that thins at the start of shot 2; both magicians keep their positions, raised wands and mirrored pose across the cut.
shots.description: At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a closer two-shot framed from the waist up, centred between the two magicians. The smoke thins from the top down and drifts off to the sides with a soft hiss, uncovering first the two top hats and then the costumes: <Subject 1>, on the left, now wears a white tailcoat, white waistcoat, white bow tie and white top hat, while <Subject 2>, on the right, now wears a black tailcoat, black waistcoat, black bow tie and black top hat. Both pairs of gloves stay black and remain clearly visible where each hand grips its wand, and both magicians keep their wands raised in the same matched pose, still facing the audience. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed until the two costumes and the two pairs of gloves fill the frame. The shot ends as the last of the smoke clears and the two magicians stand revealed in the exchanged costumes.

shots.content_purpose: Show the bow to the audience, then the red side curtains sweeping closed behind the magicians and shifting from deep red to deep blue as the closing image.
shots.cut_reason: The bow and the closing curtain need a framing that contains the floor, the backdrop and both curtain edges, which the waist-up two-shot of shot 2 cannot hold.
shots.continuity_bridge: Shot 2 ends with both magicians standing on their own side of the stage, facing the audience with new costume colours and wands raised; shot 3 begins with the same two figures in the same positions lowering their wands to bow.
shots.description: At 00:03.600, the shot cuts to a wider framing of the stage that includes the floor, both side curtains and the backdrop. The two magicians lower their wands, then sweep their hats and arms down and bow forward together toward the audience, holding the bow, as a brief light swell of applause comes from the silhouetted audience. With the bow complete, the gold cords on the red side curtains slip loose and the two panels sweep inward from both edges with a soft fabric rustle, crossing the backdrop behind the magicians and meeting at the centre of the stage. As the panels meet and settle, the fabric colour shifts from deep red to deep blue. The camera holds a static wide shot so that both curtain edges and the full stage stay in frame. The shot ends on the fully closed deep-blue curtain with the two magicians still bowed in front of it, and no action follows.
